JOURNEY TO THE MOON

Chapter 12 · The splashdown

Seven kilometres up, falling at 130 metres a second, the fire behind you. The top of the capsule is blown off, the two drogues snap out, and then the three great orange and white main parachutes: look up through the windows over your head. Six minutes under them, down to the Pacific in the morning sun, and the capsule riding the swell. Sit down in a chair before you start.

In the headset: B runs time faster and A slower (hold A for real time), ten times at most; X is the big window to your left, Y looks from outside, right stick press to sit right again.

On this screen: drag to look, Space start or pause, W faster, S slower, C window, O outside, the number keys jump.
